 BRRRR it’s cold out here, turn that heat UP!
 Bundle up, and stay warm!
 Katie Garner , The Morning Show Meteorologist , Jacksonville, FL 
 Published:  November 15, 2026 at 7:22 AM Tags:  forecast . (.) We started on a chilly note across Northeast Florida and Southeast Georgia, with frost and freezing temperatures a concern for some inland communities. A Freeze Warning and Frost Advisory remain in effect for portions of the area through 9 AM. Coastal locations will stay a bit milder, but it’s certainly a cool start!
 Today: Plenty of sunshine with highs in the mid-60s. Northeasterly winds at 8–14 mph, gusting near 20 mph, will keep a cool breeze in place throughout the afternoon. Mostly clear skies tonight with lows falling into the lower 50s along the coast and colder temperatures inland.
 Recommended Videos
 Monday–Tuesday: Our gradual warming trend begins, with highs climbing into the upper 60s. Clouds increase Monday, and northeast winds strengthen, with gusts reaching 25–30 mph by Tuesday. A few isolated showers become possible late Monday night into Tuesday, but most neighborhoods stay dry.
 Midweek: Temperatures return to the lower 70s Wednesday, with a 30% chance of showers and a few thunderstorms possible during the afternoon. Breezy conditions continue, especially near the coast.
 Late Week: The warming trend continues Thursday through Saturday, with highs reaching the mid-70s and plenty of sunshine returning. A stray shower is possible Thursday morning, but Friday and Saturday look largely dry and pleasant.
 Big weather takeaways: A chilly start Sunday, a persistent and increasingly gusty northeast breeze early in the week, a limited chance of midweek showers, and a gradual return to the 70s as we head toward next weekend.
